title: Registered strategy catalogue (frozen before backtest)
statement: Registration is frozen before any 2026 result is graded. Every strategy names its bet type, entry rule, source of prices, and which gates can currently be evaluated. 'Blocked' means a required input does not exist in any official source reachable by this project; it is never replaced with a proxy price.

strategies.name: Spread singles (divergence)
strategies.entry: Back our originated side when |our spread - market spread| >= 2.0 points at kick-off.
strategies.status: BLOCKED — no licensed/official market price archive
strategies.measurable_proxy: Margin-forecast MAE vs naive baseline (skill, not ROI)

strategies.name: Total singles (divergence)
strategies.entry: Back over/under our side when |our total - market total| >= 2.0 points.
strategies.status: BLOCKED — no licensed/official market price archive

strategies.name: Moneyline value singles
strategies.entry: Back team when our fair win probability exceeds the implied probability of the market price by >= 3 points.
strategies.status: BLOCKED — no licensed/official market price archive

strategies.name: Cross-game 2-leg parlays
strategies.entry: Combine two S1/S2 legs from different games on the same slate.
strategies.status: BLOCKED — prices missing; game-level leg correlation measured separately

strategies.name: Player-prop combos (2-3 legs)
strategies.entry: QB passing-yards over + his WR receptions over, etc., priced with measured joint distribution.
strategies.prices_required: Official per-game player logs AND prop prices
strategies.status: BLOCKED — league publishes no per-game player logs via any page in scope and no prop prices exist officially
strategies.measurable_proxy: None — nothing graded without official per-game player outcomes

strategies.name: Same-game parlay (SGP)
strategies.entry: Team total over + RB rush-yards over + game over, priced with a copula on measured joint data.
strategies.status: BLOCKED — same as S5, plus SGP pricing is proprietary

luck_removal_design: Skill is separated from luck by: (1) walk-forward-only prediction; (2) a frozen holdout (weeks 8-10) never used for tuning; (3) 10,000 label-shuffled placebo runs — a signal must beat the 95th percentile to be called skill; (4) week-clustered bootstrap CIs (game outcomes within a week are dependent); (5) pre-registered gates committed to git before results existed; (6) no strategy may claim skill from in-sample fit.
